title: The Drawing of Lots
text: A spirit squats at the crossroads, a bag of skin and grins rattling a cup of bones. One House pays the toll for all, it croons, and the bones will decide which. It has done this a long time. It is never wrong, it says, and never kind.

options.label: Let the bones choose, and accept whatever they decide.

outcomes.text: The bones fall. The spirit grins at one House, which pays, and the grin lingers.

options.label: The richest House offers to pay for all, sparing the others the bones.

outcomes.text: The spirit is impressed, which is rare. It tells everyone it meets.

options.label: Refuse the toll; no bag of bones decides your fate.

outcomes.text: The spirit takes its due another way. It has brought friends to collect.
